t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two key rules: 1) The gnomes always are in the same pairs2) The colour of the gnome determines whether it goes to a bright forest or dark forest. The Orange green pink and blue go to the bright forest and the others go to the dark forest. It doesn't matter on the size or shape of the gnome just the forest.

vb_textbox.text: Hello The idea of the game is to collect the most mushrooms. In each round there are two gnomes that always have the same colours together. The Orange, Green, Red and Blue gnomes lead to the bright forest with a red basket. When I have tried both forests, the gnomes in the bright forest seem to give more points. I went with either an orange, green, red or blue gnome and achieved more than 4000 points. Good luck
